Finally, I wanted to discuss some vacation requests.
A number of drivers have asked me for time off later this month.
But you know, it's the holiday season.
Shipping volumes for the next four weeks have increased by forty percent.
And in fact, we're going to be so busy that we just hired some temporary help.
So, to those who submitted requests, if you want to take a vacation after the holidays, I'm going to return your request forms to you so you can resubmit them with new dates.
context.transcript_translation:
最后，我想讨论一些休假申请。
有许多司机向我提出了在本月晚些时候休假的请求。
但你知道，这是假期季节。
未来四周的运输量增加了百分之四十。
事实上，我们会非常忙碌，以至于我们刚刚雇了一些临时帮工。
所以，对于提交了请求的人，如果你想在节假日后休假，我要把你的申请表退给你，这样你可以用新的日期重新提交它们。
